captions.detailed: This 3D model features a modern bicycle dropper seatpost assembly with an attached saddle. The lower assembly consists of a straight black outer tube clamped at the bottom by a seat tube binder ring, topped by a locking collar with a horizontal actuation lever. Extending telescopically from the collar is a black inner post that terminates at a two-bolt saddle rail clamp plate. The wedge-shaped black saddle is mounted to the clamp plate via thin metallic rails.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a two-bolt collar dropper seatpost with an attached saddle. The model should feature an outer tube with a bottom clamp, a locking collar with an actuation lever, and an inner telescoping post on a prismatic joint that connects to a saddle rail clamp and a black wedge-shaped saddle.
captions.factory: The code constructs an ArticulatedObject by first building a base 'outer_tube' part using a cylinder, a bottom clamping ring, and a mid-height locking collar cylinder with a protruding rectangular lever. An inner telescoping post ('inner_post') is modeled as a narrower cylinder connected to the outer tube via a prismatic joint. At the top of the inner post, a saddle assembly is created by combining a rail clamp base, thin cylindrical rails, and a lofted/extruded wedge-shaped saddle body.
